about: Round-trip harness self-check (PLAN-continuous §14): each reference page is written by hand from the synthetic ground truth of `scenario`. expect=pass: every judged compare row must PASS. expect=fail: the compare must FAIL, every row in must_fail must FAIL, and every row in must_pass must still PASS (so the failure is attributed to the right behaviour). known_fail: rows that fail for a documented measurement limitation of the pipeline (not of the reference page); they are reported as known, never as PASS.

known_fail.scroller.box: pipeline region width follows H.264 spill at the viewport edges: the replica PNGs change exactly on x 260-1019 (truth); with the unpadded box (P2e) the CRF-18 source measures 761 px and the encoded replica 763-764 px (it was 765/768/771 px at CRF 14/18/23 with the old 2 px pad); ±2 px is at this noise floor (fix belongs in pipeline/continuous region refinement or the §14 tolerance)

known_fail.fwd e3(text).color duration: thin-text colour timing is the noisiest transition measurement (source timing confidence 0.60, low band): truth 200 ms, source measures 188 ms, replica 217 ms; each is within PLAN §11.4 of the truth (±20 ms) but their difference (29 ms) exceeds the ±20 ms §14 tolerance, which equals the single-measurement accuracy
